name: Palti
bio: Palti was the son of Laish, from Gallim. During David's years as a fugitive, Saul gave Michal, David's wife, to Palti in marriage instead (1 Samuel 25:44). When David later became king and demanded Michal back from Saul's son Ish-Bosheth, Palti followed behind her weeping all the way to Bahurim, until Abner ordered him to turn back — an account told in 2 Samuel 3.
